The formula for the **standard error for the sample proportion** is:  
$$
  \text{s.e.}(\hat{p}) = \sqrt{\frac{\hat{p} \times (1 - \hat{p})}{n}}.
$$

In this formula:

1. What does\ $\hat{p}$ represent?
\greyboxlines{1}
2. What does\ $n$ represent?
\greyboxlines{1}
3. What is "$\text{s.e.}$" an abbreviation for?
\greyboxlines{1}
